## Variables

A **variable** is a characteristic of a person or thing that can be recorded as a number or a category.

The people or things being observed are called **observational units**.

A characteristic is a variable when its value can differ from one observational unit to another.

::: {.notes}
Examples adapted from https://mathplosion.gitlab.io/intro-statistics-bookdown/variables.html
:::

## 1. Hair Color

For every student in a class, record the student's hair color.

| Observational unit | Hair color |
|:--|:--|
| Student 1 | Brown |
| Student 2 | Red |
| Student 3 | Green |
| Student 4 | Brown |

## 1. Hair Color

For every student in a class, record the student's hair color.

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| Observational units | ? |
| Characteristic recorded | ? |
| Can the value differ from student to student? | ? |
| Is it a variable? | ? |

## 1. Hair Color {.answer-slide}

For every student in a class, record the student's hair color.

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| Observational units | Students in the class |
| Characteristic recorded | Hair color |
| Can the value differ from student to student? | Yes |
| Is it a variable? | **Yes** |

Hair color is a variable because different students can have different hair colors.

## 2. Instructor's Age

For every student in a class, record the age of the instructor. The class has one instructor who is 33 years old.

| Observational unit | Instructor's age |
|:--|:--|
| Student 1 | 33 |
| Student 2 | 33 |
| Student 3 | 33 |
| Student 4 | 33 |

## 2. Instructor's Age

For every student in a class, record the age of the instructor.

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| Observational units | ? |
| Characteristic recorded | ? |
| Can the value differ from student to student? | ? |
| Is it a variable? | ? |

## 2. Instructor's Age {.answer-slide}

For every student in a class, record the age of the instructor.

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| Observational units | Students in the class |
| Characteristic recorded | Their instructor's age |
| Can the value differ from student to student? | No |
| Is it a variable? | **No** |

The value does not vary because every student has the same instructor.

|:--|:--|
| Student 1 | 159 |
| Student 2 | 159 |
| Student 3 | 159 |
| Student 4 | 159 |

## 4. Height of the Shortest Student {.answer-slide}

For every student, record the height of the shortest student in the class.

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| Observational units | Students in the class |
| Characteristic recorded | Height of the class's shortest student |
| Can the value differ from student to student? | No |
| Is it a variable? | **No** |

This height summarizes the whole class. It does not vary from student to student.

For every student in a class, record the ZIP code of the student's hometown.

| Observational unit | ZIP code |
|:--|:--|
| Student 1 | 10001 |
| Student 2 | 08619 |
| Student 3 | 90210 |
| Student 4 | 11211 |

## 5. ZIP Code

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|

| Characteristic recorded | ? |
| Can the value differ from student to student? | ? |
| Is it a variable? | ? |

## 5. ZIP Code {.answer-slide}

For every student in a class, record the ZIP code of the student's hometown.

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| Observational units | Students in the class |
| Characteristic recorded | Hometown ZIP code |
| Can the value differ from student to student? | Yes |
| Is it a variable? | **Yes** |

ZIP code is a variable. Although ZIP codes use digits, the digits identify categories rather than amounts.

## Is It a Variable?

First identify the **observational units**.

Then identify the characteristic recorded for each observational unit.

Ask whether the value can differ from one observational unit to another.

If every observational unit must have the same value, the characteristic is not a variable for those units.
